A long time ago a man left his house to never come back again. He had been searching for something and had been unable to find it. After wandering for a long time, he eventually found what he was looking for, but it had cost him dearly. As he slowly made his way backward he regretted not going in the right direction from the beginning. He had wanted to go back only one night and instead chose to continue walking in the dark with rain, and to pass away in his last moments regretting not turning when he had the chance.
